answer: Require every new agent to pass a live face check before it earns weight: a short video proves a real person is present, and its face template is compared with every template already on file, so one person cannot register twice. A relic photo fails the liveness test, and a plume of smoke on a screen cannot fake depth or movement. Each voyage through registration therefore maps to one human face. An attacker chasing 1,000 fakes must recruit 1,000 distinct people at about $10 each, roughly $10,000, while one honest operator passes once.
